choices: An old deserted city buried in the jungle
A group of caves high in the cold mountains
The winter den of the Seeonee wolf pack
A deep pool where the water-snakes lived
questions.evidence: an old deserted city, lost and buried in the jungle

questions.q: Why did Bagheera and Kaa leave Baloo behind on the journey to the Cold Lairs?
choices: Baloo was too slow, and they dared not wait for him
Baloo was needed to guard the wolf cubs at home
Baloo was afraid of Kaa and refused to travel with him
Baloo had gone to find Hathi and ask for his help
questions.evidence: We dare not wait for thee.

questions.q: On the way to the Cold Lairs, where did Bagheera get ahead of Kaa?
choices: At a hill stream, which he leaped across while Kaa swam
On a steep hillside, where the snake slid back down
In thick bamboo, where Kaa's long body got stuck
On level ground, where his four feet were fastest
questions.evidence: When they came to a hill stream, Bagheera gained

questions.q: How did the monkeys treat the ruined city they called their own?

They guarded it carefully and let no other animals come inside
They used its rooms wisely to store food for the dry season
questions.evidence: they never knew what the buildings were made for nor how to use them

They tore up his work and made him start all over
They asked him to teach them every night for a week
questions.evidence: in a very few minutes they lost interest

questions.q: Why did Mowgli go hungry in the Cold Lairs?

The monkeys ate all the nuts themselves and laughed at the hungry boy
There was no food at all growing anywhere in the old ruined city
Mowgli would not eat the monkeys' food because it was against the Law
questions.evidence: they fell to fighting on the road

questions.q: What did Mowgli decide about Baloo's warnings while he wandered through the empty city?

Baloo would never come to find him in such a far place

questions.q: What did the monkeys keep shouting to prove they were wonderful?
choices: This is true; we all say so
We be of one blood, ye and I
Good hunting to all the jungle
The jungle has noticed us at last
questions.evidence: This is true; we all say so.

Kaa could not see well at night just after changing his skin
They hoped the monkeys would fall asleep when it grew dark
questions.evidence: When that cloud covers the moon I shall go to the terrace

Into a deep dry well in the middle of the city square
Up into the highest tower on the crumbling west wall
Inside a dark tunnel that led beneath the king's palace

He kept perfectly still and they never saw him

Climb up onto the wall
Run back into the jungle
Call for Hathi the elephant

choices: Wrongdoing is punished, and then the matter is settled for good

questions.evidence: punishment settles all scores. There is no nagging afterward.
